@astryx.pagination.previous.description: Aria label for the previous-page button.

@astryx.pagination.next.description: Aria label for the next-page button.

@astryx.selector.placeholder.description: Placeholder text on an empty Selector trigger button (a dropdown). Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character. Very short — appears on the button face.

@astryx.complexSelector.placeholder.description: Placeholder text on an empty ComplexSelector trigger button. Same English as `selector.placeholder` but a separate key — the custom surface may warrant different phrasing in some locales. Imperative verb; trailing `…` is one character.
